Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a superior court judge to be a qualified voter in a county served by the superior court he or she is elected or appointed to.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to superior court judge qualifications; and addinga new section to chapter 2.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 2.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person may not be elected or appointed to the office of judgeof the superior court unless he or she is a qualified voter in a countyserved by that superior court. (2) Superior court judges who have been elected or appointed as ofthe effective date of this section may serve the remainder of theircurrent term of office, regardless of their status as a qualified voterin a county served by the superior court for which they were elected orappointed.
